caption:
Some craters here never see the Sun. They likely hold water ice.

The Moon’s south pole is a NASA mosaic of about 1,500 images.
Crater floors stay in shadow. Some peaks get sunlight almost all the time.
The big basin, lower right, is Schrödinger. It is 320 km wide.

What the astronomers say: This region is a prime place for the first Moon base, and Artemis may land nearby.

NASA picture: JPL, PIA00001. Clementine mission, south pole mosaic.
